Amy hopes to visit London one day. Jack is interested in swimming. Amy usually has rice for breakfast. What's more, tomatoes grow well in sunny gardens.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the spring market by bike. The spring market is one of the best places in the city. Jack's birthday is in February. In fact, his father is a doctor.
Amy drinks water after doing sports. The weather was windy that day. There are always many people at the lantern street.
